changelogBody:
Questie 12.4.0

Build: f8938f4

New Features

  • Added quest focus buttons to the tracker (BreakBB)
  • Show tracked profession recipes in the tracker (BreakBB)

General Fixes

  • Don't announce Day of the Dead in Era and TBC (Cabro)
  • Improved quest tag info retry handling (Huijie Wei)
  • Keep tracker indent for quests with two faded quest item buttons (BreakBB)
  • Removed objective focus from the tracker menu (BreakBB)
  • Show repeatable type of quest in QBZ/QBF when possible (Cabro)
  • Slightly speed up the map icon flash animation (BreakBB)

Localization Fixes

  • [zhCN] Use correct term for "Dungeons" (Loukky)

QuestieDB 1.0.10

Build: a37877c

Database Fixes

  • [Forever] Add NPC ranks (BreakBB)
  • [Forever] Add fraction digits for reputation spillover (BreakBB)
